checklist_spec.companion: Soundcheck runs BEFORE the Radio Dial scripts. Dial supplies the talk-break templates and the {{verified_fact}} placeholder discipline; SOUNDCHECK is the gate that decides whether each fact earns the mic.

item_fields.note: context for the reader — dates, caveats, payola flags, cut instructions
item_fields.script_line: the exact line in the talk-break script this item came from
item_fields.source: who confirmed it; EMPTY when nobody did
item_fields.source_date: YYYY-MM-DD the source was observed (omit when no source)
item_fields.stat_or_credit: what kind of claim this is: 'stat: …' or 'credit: …'
item_fields.status: pass | fail | flag — recomputed by check.py; a stated status that disagrees with the computed one fails the run
item_fields.verified_value: the value a source confirms; EMPTY when nothing confirms it

checklist_spec.purpose: Before an agent goes on air, every stat and credit it plans to read runs through the checklist: claimed value vs verified value, source, pass/fail/flag. No busted stats on the air.
status_rules: FAIL when verified_value is empty, or source is empty, or the note names unverified / payola / cut-from-read. A fail item must be CUT from the read.
FLAG when a verified_value exists but the claimed text does not match it (case/punctuation-insensitive). Reword to the verified_value or cut.
PASS when claimed matches verified_value and a named source with a date is present.
Overall verdict: any FAIL → NO-GO. Any FLAG and no FAIL → GO-WITH-CUTS. Otherwise → GO.
